name: Sunbelt Rentals Holdings Inc.
summary: Sunbelt Rentals Holdings Inc. operates as a prominent equipment leasing firm, furnishing an extensive array of tools, various machinery, and customized engineering solutions. Its clientele spans diverse sectors including construction, industrial applications, and other specialized industries. The company's operations are divided into three core business units: its general tool services across North America, its specialty services also within North America, and its division in the United Kingdom. Established on February 12, 2025, Sunbelt Rentals Holdings Inc. has its corporate base located in Fort Mill, South Carolina.
